# FixFlow Maintenance & WhatsApp Dispatch Portal

> FixFlow is a web portal for property managers, tenants and technicians to raise, assign, track and resolve maintenance tickets, with automated WhatsApp notifications, technician dispatching, inventory management and resolution analytics.

## What it does
- Tenant portal: submit maintenance requests with photos and track status
- Admin dashboard: ticket pipeline, technician assignment, resolution analytics
- Technician view: assigned jobs, status updates, parts used
- WhatsApp hub: automated status messages to tenants and technicians
- Inventory manager: spare-parts stock and low-stock alerts

## Notes
- Demo data runs entirely in the browser; no personal data is sent to a server.
